title: 16 蟾蜍子17 辞行18 大树村
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：不用数兜里的银子就知道不够用，就算加上那只黄厉级老狐尸体200两，贺堪全身上下也不过才250两，要是全买了，贺堪回家的路费都不够。
选的时候开心，付钱的时候就很痛苦了。
万物司不愧是万物司，在偌大监天司负责宝物兑换的司，光是贺堪去的白游级仓库，一路上遇到的好东西就数不胜数，很多材料以贺堪上辈子挑剔的目光都觉得眼馋无比。
真的是好东西啊。
只可惜听到价格就足够让贺堪退让了，是他不配。
还差30两，青铜血石与复脸蟾蜍的毒刺都是贺堪想要的，又十分适合当做他想做的祭器长矛，比预算多出了30两而已，他已经正式进入了仪征司，那新入职的薪银也自然会到手。
正当贺堪下定决心跟谢平平先借东西抵一会儿的时候。
微胖少年就先开口了。
“不过你这老狐诡物尸体十分不错，虽然是邪诡士，这身皮毛却是诡力满溢，恐怕在黄厉级中也是数一数二，品相也十分完整。”
微胖少年笑着开口，别说什么邪诡士是人，人身上的器官不能用。
这些话对于这个世界上每时每刻都在担惊受怕，很可能下一秒就被诡物吃了的人类来讲，这些都是虚的，拼尽全力的活下去，努力的活下去，才是最重要的。
邪诡士还吃人呢，吃人的东西已经不算人，只能算诡物了，它们更不配活着，与其让这些材料浪费不如让活着的人使用。
狐类诡物在诡士们中也十分受欢迎，那身皮毛可以做出不错的防具，还能兼美观与保暖，怎么看都划算。
“万物阁可以出300两。”
微胖少年手指捻了一下那老狐尸体上苍白茂密的毛发尖，心中点头，随后开口评价了几句，说完，抬头看向贺堪：“你意下如何？”
这么多？
贺堪反而是有些惊讶，他记得上一次的那个鲛人反而只有200两来着？
贺堪后来一想，反而明白了，说白了，这只老狐的主要价值是在它的一身毛皮，这毛皮是黄厉级，不少诡士喜欢追捧防具，反而那鲛人不成人形，说是鲛人其实就是个鱼形的肉团，几乎没什么有用的材料，估计那200两也是看在邹平司的面子上给的。
“可以。”
贺堪点头，这毛皮给他也没什么用，他更喜欢穿布的。

谢平平看着贺堪这是谈妥了，一直都没有出声的他终于开口了，转头看向微胖少年，语气不爽的道：“嘿，我说蟾蜍子，这是我带来的朋友，这两样材料价格你是一点都不少？”
“别忘了，咱们什么关系！
！”
还别说，谢平平发挥作用的时候是真的稳当，该出手时就出手。
微胖少年、也就是蟾蜍子，表情变都没变，他微笑的看着谢平平，道：“你知道这是给出的最低价格了吗？那只复脸蟾蜍的毒刺，快要上黄厉级了，我给他算的是白游级的价格，换个旁人过来，价格我要个翻倍都不是问题。”
主要是复脸蟾蜍也是比较稀有难缠的诡物了。
蟾蜍子是真的看在谢平平的份上给了不小优惠。
“………”
谢平平，谢平平当然知道了啊，但他知道自己好友绝对还留有余地，东西可以不卖，但是钱不能不赚。
“谁不知道你会偷偷赚点啊。”
谢平平在蟾蜍子目光转移的时候，忍不住低头小声的嘀咕道。
content_en:
: You don’t need to count the money in your pocket to know that it is not enough. Even if you add the 200 taels of the corpse of the Huangli-level old fox, He Kan’s whole body only has 250 taels. If you buy them all, He Kan’s travel expenses home will not be enough.
It’s fun when you choose, but it’s painful when you pay.
The Department of All Things is worthy of being the Department of All Things. In the department where Supervisor Tiansi is responsible for treasure exchange, just the Baiyou-level warehouse that He Kan went to, there were countless good things he encountered along the way. Many of the materials made He Kan extremely greedy with his picky eyes in his previous life.
It's really good stuff.
It's a pity that hearing the price was enough to make He Kan give in. He didn't deserve it.
There is still 30 taels left. The bronze bloodstone and the stinger of the compound-faced toad are both what He Kan wants, and they are very suitable for use as the sacrificial spear he wants to make. It is only 30 taels more than the budget. He has officially entered the Yizheng Department, and the newly hired salary will naturally be obtained.
Just when He Kan made up his mind to borrow something from Xie Pingping for a while.
The fat boy spoke first.
"But the body of your old fox monster is very good. Although it is an evil monster, its fur is full of ghost power. I am afraid it is one of the best among the Huang Li level, and its appearance is also very complete."
The fat boy smiled and said, "Don't say that the evil sorcerer is a human being, and the organs in the human body cannot be used."
These words are false to human beings in this world who are always worried and may be eaten by strange things in the next second. Trying your best to live and working hard is the most important thing.
The evil sorcerers still eat people. The things that eat people are no longer considered human beings, but can only be regarded as treacherous objects. They are not worthy of being alive. Instead of letting these materials go to waste, it is better to let living people use them.
Fox-like monsters are also very popular among the tricksters. The fur can be used to make good armor, and it is both beautiful and warm. It is cost-effective no matter how you look at it.
"Wanwu Pavilion can produce 300 taels."
The fat young man twisted the tips of the pale and thick hair on the old fox corpse with his fingers, nodded in his mind, and then commented a few words. After speaking, he raised his head and looked at He Kan: "What do you think?"
So many?
He Kan was a little surprised. He remembered that the shark from last time only had 200 taels?
He Kan thought about it later and understood. To put it bluntly, the main value of this old fox is its fur, which is of the Huangli level. Many warlords like to pursue armor. On the contrary, the shark is not human-shaped. It is said that the shark is actually a fish-shaped meat ball with almost no useful materials. It is estimated that the 200 taels were given to Zouping Si for his sake.
"Okay."
He Kan nodded. This fur was of no use to him. He preferred to wear cloth.
Xie Pingping saw that He Kan had reached an agreement. He who had been silent until now finally spoke. He turned to look at the fat boy and said in an unhappy tone: "Hey, Toad Zi, this is the friend I brought. Do you think the price of these two materials is not much at all?"
"Don't forget, what is our relationship?
! "
Not to mention, Xie Pingping is really stable when he is playing his role, and he takes action when it is time to take action.
The fat boy, also known as Toad, did not change his expression. He looked at Xie Pingping with a smile and said, "Do you know this is the lowest price given? The stinger of the compound-faced toad is about to reach the Huangli level. I calculated the price for him at the Baiyou level. If someone else comes over, it won't be a problem for me to double the price."
The main reason is that the compound-faced toad is also a relatively rare and difficult monster.
Toadzi really gave Xie Pingping a big discount for his sake.
"..."
Xie Pingping, of course Xie Pingping knew, but he knew that his friend definitely still had room for success. He didn't have to sell things, but he had to make money.
"Who doesn't know you can make some money secretly?"
When Toadzi's eyes shifted, Xie Pingping couldn't help lowering his head and muttering softly.
